summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Intermap Technologies Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 24, 2026. The filing includes a report of voting results and a press release. Shareholders voted on the election of three directors and the reappointment of auditors. All nominees were elected and the auditor appointment passed. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure, not a special situation.
